title: Explicit formulae for stochastic equilibria
summary: Finding the stochastic equilibria for finite-state stochastic matrices amounts to solving an eigen\-vector problem $π= πP$. Various techniques for doing so are known, some extremely computationally intensive. Herein we shall aim to extract a number of relatively simple analytic results that shed light on this problem. It is very easy to find an explicit general formula for the equilibrium vector (when it is unique) of a $2\times 2$ stochastic matrix.
